paper_title: Searching for Axion-Like Particles with the Blazar Observations of MAGIC and Fermi-LAT
notes: Astrophysical ALP-photon oscillation bound from Mrk 421 blazar observations by MAGIC+Fermi-LAT. Combined 95% C.L. excludes g_agamma >~ 2e-11 GeV^-1 for 8e-9 eV <~ m_a <~ 2e-7 eV. Only the corner/approximate bounding values are given in text; the full exclusion contour is in Fig. 4 (not numerically tabulated). Data points represent the quoted rectangular exclusion region edges, not a precise contour.
